description: One-byte Fletcher-16 update of a packed state (two sums modulo 255)
notes: Per-byte body of the Fletcher-16 checksum with sums modulo 255, as on the Wikipedia page (RFC 1146 defines the same 8-bit algorithm with ones' complement accumulators), with the two sums packed in a u16; function written by us. clang trunk -O3 -march=skylake keeps the first urem by 255 (its operand can reach 510, since the incoming sums are not assumed reduced) and turns the second into a compare and select: 12 IR instructions. Whether a cheaper exact form exists is unknown.
